records.name: vms-laxdriver (tier6-laxdriver)
records.description: LAX0: Load Average eXtended driver for 64-bit OpenVMS -- a real VMS device driver in C using fixed-point arithmetic, plus a test harness that opens/reads the device.
records.vms_apis_exercised: Device driver structure, $QIO-style device I/O, DCL test harness
records.notes: NEW this session. Cloned commit b6e15c2d9b7b98953814e022c9e66dd3e0949cf0 (2022-06-17), landed at tests/corpus/tier6-laxdriver/. Highest-value new source find: a real kernel-adjacent driver, not just an RTL-calling application -- exercises VMS I/O driver APIs nothing else in the corpus touches.

records.name: vms-ipc_benchmark (tier6-ipc-benchmark)
records.description: IPC benchmark suite ported to OpenVMS: pipes, FIFOs, UNIX-domain sockets, TCP, UDP, POSIX message queues, shared memory, socketpair -- one small C program per IPC mechanism.
records.vms_apis_exercised: Mailboxes/pipes, shared memory ($CRMPSC-family), POSIX IPC on VMS CRTL
records.notes: NEW this session. Cloned commit 1a1175981bfbe6dc5f4f3d9c1caab18d008e9a21 (2023-10-07), landed at tests/corpus/tier6-ipc-benchmark/. Broad IPC API surface in one small repo.

records.name: vms-memtester (tier6-memtester)
records.description: Port of the classic memtester memory-diagnostic tool to 64-bit OpenVMS (Alpha, IA64, x86).
records.notes: NEW this session. Cloned commit 6f95a02610918e590741c7bbac5cb69ae90c4126 (2022-05-12), landed at tests/corpus/tier6-memtester/.

records.name: cmatrix (tier6-cmatrix)

records.name: WASD HTTP Server -- x86-64 object-module kit
records.description: 226 precompiled x86-64 OpenVMS .OBJ modules (WASD v12.4.0), built with VSI C x86-64 V7.7-003 on OpenVMS x86_64 V9.2-3. Requires WASD1240.ZIP + WASD's INSTALL/UPDATE DCL procedures to link into runnable images.
records.vms_apis_exercised: CGI/CGIplus, WebSockets, AST-driven async I/O, process control (compiled, not yet linked)
records.notes: TOP BINARY FIND. Real VSI-compiled x86-64 OpenVMS object code, Apache-2.0, dated Jan 2026 -- but these are unlinked .OBJ modules, not a runnable image or ELF file; OVMX's activator cannot run them as-is. Next step toward an actual runnable artifact: run WASD's INSTALL.COM on a real VMS x86-64 system (or once OVMX's own LINK.EXE is far enough along) to produce linked images, THEN test those against IMGACT.EXE. Fetch script: tests/corpus/fetch/wasd.sh.

records.name: WASD HTTP Server -- source kit
records.description: Full WASD v12.4.0 source: AST-based async I/O, CGI/CGIplus, WebSockets, process pooling. 30+ years of VMS-native web server development.
records.vms_apis_exercised: ASTs, $QIO async I/O, process spawn/control, security/authentication
records.notes: Prerequisite for the x86-64 object kit above. Over the 5MB commit threshold. Fetch script: tests/corpus/fetch/wasd.sh.

records.name: John Francis PCSI Kits -- Alpha (AXP)
records.description: ~67 PCSI-installable packages (zlib, libpng, libjpeg, libxml2, MySQL, Python, OpenSSL 0.9.x, FreeType, LibGD, etc) prebuilt as linked OpenVMS Alpha shareable images, with full source under SOURCES/.
records.size_estimate: tens of MB total; individual kits 200KB-45MB
records.vms_apis_exercised: varies by package; broad RTL + file I/O
records.notes: Best available source of LINKED Alpha OpenVMS binaries outside VSI's gated portal. Harder target than x86-64 ELF (Alpha image format, no OVMX activator support), so lower near-term priority despite volume. Fetch script: tests/corpus/fetch/john-francis-pcsi.sh.

records.name: John Francis PCSI Kits -- Itanium (IA64)
records.description: Itanium counterpart to the AXP kit collection above -- same package set, IA64-linked images.
records.notes: Lowest near-term priority of the three architectures OVMX might target (x86-64 ELF > Alpha > Itanium, per task ranking). Fetch script: tests/corpus/fetch/john-francis-pcsi.sh.

records.name: Digiater.nl OpenVMS Freeware CD mirror (v1.0-v8.0)
records.description: Full historic Freeware CD collection, ~600+ packages in the v8.0 snapshot alone (2009), VAX/Alpha/Itanium era. Mixed source, VMS .EXE binaries, and BACKUP savesets per package.
records.license: mixed, mostly GPL but verify per package
records.size_estimate: unknown aggregate, likely GB-scale across all 600+ packages
records.vms_apis_exercised: comprehensive -- entire historic VMS freeware ecosystem
records.notes: Too large and too heterogeneous to enumerate individually in this pass. Fetch script pulls a curated subset (find, flist, gzip, bzip2, unzip, zip) and documents the browse URL for more. License-first: verify each package before use.

records.name: plibsys
records.description: Cross-platform C system library: threads, sockets (TCP/UDP/SCTP), IPC, hashing, RB/AVL trees. OpenVMS Alpha/IA64 (DEC C) backend documented in the wiki.
records.vms_apis_exercised: POSIX threads on VMS, shared memory, atomic ops (named semaphores/shm noted broken on VMS 8.4+ upstream)

records.name: VSI official PCSI ECO kits (GNV V3.0-2F, VSI C++, PERF_UPD, etc.)
records.description: VSI's own compiled PCSI kits for OpenVMS x86-64 (GNV, C++ compiler, performance updates) -- genuine x86-64 VMS binaries, likely ELF, gated behind the licensed sp.vmssoftware.com service platform.
records.notes: EXCLUDED. These are VSI-authored, copyrighted binaries distributed only to licensed Community/commercial accounts via sp.vmssoftware.com. Acquiring or redistributing them would be ingesting VSI-proprietary material, squarely outside Rule 8's clean-room boundary and constraint 2 (no OS/VSI-proprietary material). Recorded here as a lead only -- do not fetch.
